description: The Individuals in this job are trained to conduct dry and wet Cupping Therapy procedures as per defined scope of practice. These professionals are registered Ayush and Medical professionals who ascertain treatment as per Pre, Main and Post procedures involved during therapy as per the standards. They will also assign daily activities, records of the patients and treatment follow-up at the workplace to be maintained by other support staff.
